messages:
Leah (CS): Heads-up — prepping QBR for Orion. Need a compact cost snapshot, onboarding status, and renewal-risk summary by EOD Wed. Who can own the triage?
Sam (FinOps): I can run token burn + forecast. What scope? last 30d + projected 30d?
Leah (CS): Yep 30/30. Also include top 3 routes by spend and any embedding-heavy spikes.
Jordan (Onboarding): Onboarding update: 4 active seats, 2 high-touch pilots (feature flags still pending). Will send short status bullets by lunchtime.
Aman (AE): Renewal for their enterprise seat is ~in 28 days. They're concerned about sudden cost jump from embed volume after last release — flagged at medium risk. I can do the customer convo, but need the numbers to show optimization options.
Priya (Enablement): I can prep a 1-pager for the CS <> AE call: recommended quick mitigations (prefix caching, quantized variant + rate limits) + suggested enablement playbook. Need the cost delta numbers.
billing-bot: Generated cost snapshot: https://redwood.internal/costs/snaps/1777700222 — includes token burn, per-route breakdown, and anomalies.
Sam (FinOps): quick note — I'm running this query now: `SELECT route, SUM(tokens) as tokens, SUM(cost) as cost FROM prod_billing WHERE ts > now()-interval '30 days' GROUP BY route ORDER BY cost DESC LIMIT 5;` Will paste top results in thread.
Jordan (Onboarding): Sending onboarding bullets now: 1) SSO pending 2) Ingest pipeline misconfig for embeddings 3) Perms audit in progress. Two pilots paused on heavy batching tests.
Leah (CS): Perfect. Plan: Sam publishes snapshot + short forecast by 16:00, Priya drafts 1-pager by 17:00, Jordan provides onboarding bullets by 12:30, Aman sets customer call for next Tue. I'll assemble slide deck for QBR. Tag me when done. :thumbsup: 
Aman (AE): Ack — will book the call and share invite after Sam posts numbers.
Sam (FinOps): Pasted top routes: 
- /v1/embed (tokens: 2.1M, cost: $2,450)
- /v1/generate (tokens: 1.3M, cost: $1,200)
- /v1/chat (tokens: 900k, cost: $980)
Anomaly: embed spike on 2026-03-10 at 03:12 UTC — likely batch job.
Priya (Enablement): Draft 1-pager attached in drive: https://drive.redwood/enablement/qbr-orion-1777700222 (will include mitigation playbook + talking points).
Leah (CS): Thanks everyone — this is actionable. I'll mark as done once slide deck is uploaded. If anyone hits blockers, ping here. :sparkles:
